stackDivergence.rationale: Original prim.hxx inline operations retain null callback branches, actual C interface slots, initialized mapping inout pointer and TYPELIB_DANGER_GET/RELEASE ownership, signed32 inputs with unsigned64 wrap before the unsigned32 sequence allocation guard, actual static empty sequence {1,0,{0}} and lazy acquired VOID pointer. SAL sequence header offset8 is a source logical offset; it does not claim JS binary layout. Actual Int32Array storage and existing OSL Atomics implement the address of the one original sequence count; the mutable VOID global is one cross-module pointer cell. Source empty Any construction changes only pType and normal-build pData=self, leaving initialized caller pReserved untouched. The original identical equality and TYPE_ACQUIRE bodies reuse the existing actual CPPU C predicate/acquire owner. New headers declare actual C callback/record/typedef contracts only, without fake providers, allocated Any values or complete data/sequence engines. Full unchanged original prim.hxx and 72 full SAL/CPPU translation units (including genuine any/data/sequence owners) supply normal and ASan/UBSan complete streams. Caller callbacks only record arguments/order and return a caller pointer, without substituting any native operation. Initialized copied C reference records are const equality witnesses only. Physical pointer/ABI/object lifetime, arbitrary invalid JS storage/numbers/callbacks, debug1 configuration, full data/Any/Sequence/queryInterface/Reference/default RuntimeException/case/service/UI consumers, concurrency/shutdown and full upstream QA remain unfinished or unverified. System dependencies are uninstrumented and leak detection disabled; broad parity flags remain false.
